style: Bright, bold Saturday-morning cartoon for kids ages 5-7, about goofy desert racers in a sunny junkyard wasteland. Chunky rounded shapes, thick dark outlines, saturated warm colors (sunny orange, rusty red, turquoise, lime green, golden yellow), flat cel shading with a little grit texture. Vehicles are built from junk: bolts, patches, big tires, exhaust pipes. Characters are silly and friendly with big grins. Nothing scary: no weapons, no blood, no fire hurting anyone, no real brands, no words or letters anywhere.

rules.sprite: Single character or object only, centered, whole thing visible with a little margin. Background must be one flat solid pure magenta color (#FF00FF) with no gradient, no shadow, no ground, no text, no border. Do not use magenta or hot pink anywhere on the subject.
rules.backdrop: Full-bleed painting that fills the whole frame, no text, no letters, no border.
rules.texture: Seamless tileable surface texture seen from DIRECTLY ABOVE (flat top-down, orthographic), evenly lit with no strong shadows, no horizon, no objects sticking up, no characters, no text. Fills the whole frame edge to edge.

styles.lore: Bold, punchy cartoon set in the world of Mad Max: Fury Road, for kids ages 6-8. Chunky shapes, thick dark outlines, flat cel shading with gritty texture. Chrome, rust and spikes; sun-bleached desert orange with a teal sky. War Boys are bald with chalk-white skin paint and black smudges around the eyes. Vehicles are wild chromed hot-rods built from junk. Exciting and edgy, but no blood, no gore, no injuries, no guns pointed at anyone, no real brands, no words or letters. Every character is an original cartoon design, never a likeness of a real actor.
